            uint32_t consensus_election_compute_score (const
            participant_metrics_t * metrics)
          

          

            Compute deterministic score for a participant. Higher score = better
            host candidate
          

          

          

            score = (4 - nat_tier) * 1000 // NAT tier: 0=best, 4=worst

14                                                                                 {
15   if (!metrics || metrics->nat_tier > 4 || metrics->stun_probe_success_pct > 100)
16     return 0;
17
18   // NAT tier: 0=LAN (best), 4=TURN (worst)
19   // (4 - tier) * 1000 makes LAN score 4000, TURN score 0
20   uint32_t nat_score = (4 - metrics->nat_tier) * 1000;
21
22   // Bandwidth: higher is better
23   // Divide by 10 to keep in reasonable scale (10Mbps = +1000)
24   uint32_t bw_score = metrics->upload_kbps / 10;
25
26   // Latency: lower is better
27   // (500ms - rtt_ns) means 0ns RTT = +500, 500ms = 0, high latency = negative (but capped at 0)
28   // 500ms = 500,000,000ns
29   uint32_t rtt_score = (metrics->rtt_ns < 500 * NS_PER_MS) ? (500 - (metrics->rtt_ns / NS_PER_MS)) : 0;
30
31   // STUN probe success: 0-100%
32   uint32_t probe_score = metrics->stun_probe_success_pct;
33
34   // Total score
35   uint32_t total = nat_score + bw_score + rtt_score + probe_score;
36   return total;
37 }
